I'll create a rap battle script based on the actual 2016 debate moments and themes. Let me search for more specific details about their debate exchanges. Let me search for more specific debate content and the Epic Rap Battles version for reference.

Based on my research of the actual 2016 debates and the real "Epic Rap Battles of History" version that was created, here's my original script for a Hillary vs. Trump rap battle:

---

# **PRESIDENTIAL RAP BATTLE 2016**
## *Hillary Clinton vs. Donald Trump*

---

**[BEAT DROPS — dramatic orchestral hip-hop beat]**

---

**HILLARY CLINTON:**
*(stepping to the mic, pantsuit sharp)*

Yo, I'm Hillary Rodham, been in the game for decades
While you were firing people on your fake TV escapades
I was in the West Wing, you were doing WWE
Now you wanna run the country? Boy, please.

You call women pigs, dogs, and slobs to their face
Then wonder why you're losing the female vote race
Miss Piggy, Miss Housekeeping—that's your vocabulary?
Alicia Machado's voting, and she ain't sorry!

You got skin like Russian dressing, Vlad's favorite puppet
Your tax returns hiding more than your budget
Small loan of a million? Try born on third base
Thinking you hit a triple, but you ain't got no base!

---

**DONALD TRUMP:**
*(interrupting, finger pointing)*

WRONG! Let me tell you something, nasty woman
My crowds are huge, yours put people to snoozin'
I'm the king of debt, I built towers of gold
You're the queen of emails—33,000 deleted, I'm told!

Bill Clinton was abusive, and YOU attacked those women!
Sat his accusers front row just to watch you start swimming
In your own contradictions, your establishment lies
I'm the outsider, baby—the American surprise!

I don't pay taxes 'cause I'm smart, you see
You're funded by Goldman Sachs, that's your fee
Crooked Hillary, lock her up, that's the chant
I'm winning everywhere—just look at my plants!

---

**HILLARY CLINTON:**
*(laughing dismissively)*

"Believe me," he says—his favorite phrase
Like he believes in climate change? No way!
You think global warming's a Chinese hoax
While your Florida properties flood, that's the joke

You mocked a disabled reporter, that's who you are
A bully with a Twitter feed and a leased Jaguar
You want to ban Muslims, build walls so tall
But Mexico's not paying—no deal at all!

---

**DONALD TRUMP:**
*(leaning into mic)*

I will tell you at the time—I'll keep you in suspense
Whether I'll accept results? That's common sense!
The system's rigged, the media's unfair
Everyone's against me, but I don't care!

I got stamina, believe me, it's true
Unlike you—coughing fit, nearly passed out, who knew?
I don't need briefings, I got a very good brain
My uncle taught at MIT, that's my nuclear gain!

---

**HILLARY CLINTON:**
*(pulling out phone)*

Let me Google "nuclear triad" for you real quick
Since you clearly don't know how that stick clicks
You said "the cyber," asked Russia to hack
Now you're Putin's puppet—how's that for a fact?

---

**[SUDDENLY—A THIRD FIGURE BURSTS THROUGH THE CURTAIN]**

---

**BERNIE SANDERS:**
*(wild hair, finger waving)*

EXCUSE ME! EXCUSE ME! I'm here to say
This whole battle's ridiculous in every way!
While you two argue about who's less fit
I'm still fighting for healthcare—we're not done with it!

You took my ideas, Hillary, that's fine
But where was that energy in 2009?
And Donald with your "populist" billionaire act
Your whole cabinet's Goldman Sachs—that's a fact!

I'm not part of your system, I'm still independent
My supporters are watching, still very attendant
So both of you stop with this childish display
The revolution continues—WE'RE HERE TO STAY!

---

**[BEAT STOPS ABRUPTLY]**

---

**MODERATOR (LESTER HOLT):**
*(checking watch)*

Well... that happened. Audience, who won?

**[CROWD ERUPTS—half chanting "HILL-AR-Y," half "TRUMP! TRUMP! TRUMP!" with a small but vocal "BER-NIE!" section]**

---

**HILLARY CLINTON:**
*(to camera, smiling)*

Please vote. And visit my website for fact-checking.

**DONALD TRUMP:**
*(also to camera)*

I'm the least racist person in this room. Believe me.

**BERNIE SANDERS:**
*(already walking off stage)*

Medicare for All! We'll be back in 2020!

---

**[BLACKOUT]**

---

*END OF BATTLE*

---

**Sources:**
1. https://globalnews.ca/news/3051825/donald-trump-vs-hillary-clinton-the-most-memorable-cringe-worthy-moments-from-the-2016-campaign/
2. https://www.goldderby.com/tv/2016/donald-trump-vs-hillary-clinton-epic-rap-battles-of-history/
3. https://globalnews.ca/news/3015351/presidential-debate-2016-what-donald-trump-and-hillary-clinton-said-on-iraq-syria-and-mexico/
4. https://mashable.com/video/epic-rap-battles-of-history-donald-trump-hillary-clinton
5. https://www.nydailynews.com/2016/11/06/election-2016-the-10-pivotal-gaffes-by-donald-trump-and-hillary-clinton/
6. https://www.rev.com/blog/transcripts/donald-trump-vs-hillary-clinton-1st-presidential-debate-2016
